name: Unified Paradigm UI
primaryPrinciple: Visual appeal is the first learner-facing design principle and a completion criterion.

direction.name: soft-clay picture-book post office
direction.audience: young children learning through short daily missions
direction.signature: A little mail bird carries completed learning through a fold-out storybook map.

type.display: "HanziPen SC", "Kaiti SC", "STKaiti", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", cursive

copyWorkflow: Copy the complete project folder; do not rebuild from screenshots.
Preserve tokens, component grammar, interaction shell, accessibility states, responsive layout, and image-ratio behavior.
Replace curriculum, story world, semantic assets, audio, labels, storage key, and learner-facing copy.
Make one subject-specific signature choice rather than merely recoloring.
Run node tools/validate_template.js before and after adaptation.
